title: 第六章 此事可有为难之处？
content_zh:
这座茶楼矗立在大汉神京的繁华地界，此刻二楼之上，正有几人对坐叙话。
「未知大人着人召下官，有何要事？」秦业是是个年过半百，头发灰白的老者，面色谦卑地看着对面的贾珍，开口就是以下官相称。
贾珍承袭宁国公的爵位，虽经历次减等，但如今还承继着三等爵威烈将军，比起秦业的工部营膳司郎中的五品，品阶要高上许多，更不用说还有贾族一族族长的特殊身份，秦业面对贾珍，自然不敢造次。
贾珍年纪四十出头，一身浅绿色官袍，头戴黑色无纱黑帽，面皮白净，鼻子下蓄着胡须，手中拿着一把摺扇，把玩着，面上挂着一抹笑意，笑呵呵道：「秦老大人客气了，秦老大人和我贾家也算是世交了，确有一事想与秦老大人商议，犬子贾蓉，已到议婚之龄，我闻秦郎中膝下有一女，品容上佳，宜室宜家，故而厚颜，代小儿向秦郎中求亲。」
贾珍说着，凹陷的眼窝中，浑浊的眸子里仿若现出那一张如花霰娇媚，楚楚多情的美人来。
还是中秋节前夕，他至大安寺游玩，当初碰到了，后来多番打听，才知原是来进香还愿的秦氏姐弟，其父是工部营膳司郎中，正五品。
「下官……」秦业面上神色就有些踌躇之色，道：「不瞒贾大人，小女已订了亲事，如何一女还能许两家？」
贾珍皱了皱眉，面色微变，急声道：「订了亲事？不知是哪家的年轻公子？」
秦业沉吟了下，有心不告知以实情，但对着贾珍的审视目光，道：「说来，还是贾族中人。」
「哦？」贾珍面色微顿，目光一亮，诧异道：「哪一房的公子，我为何不知？」
贾珍为贾家族长，他却是不知两府之中，有着什麽适龄男子娶亲，宝玉还小，贾琏年前才娶的亲，如是寻常族人定好亲事……
贾珍目光闪了闪，心下一松，如果是贾家在京族人订好的亲事，他身为族长，左右使些银子，威逼利诱一番就是，料那人也不敢违逆他的意思。
秦业顿了下，迟疑道：「是后街柳条儿胡同的贾四家，小名珩哥儿，在出生不久时，就定下的娃娃亲，已换过婚书。」
说到最后，秦业心头就是一叹，当年他还只是工部一小吏，因受得贾四儿夫妻的恩惠，就定了一门娃娃亲。
但时过境迁，原本门当户对的亲事，此刻多少有些……可让他开口悔婚，也决然做不出这等没脸的事来。
贾珍拧了拧眉，问着一旁的赖升，道：「后街的贾四儿？可是那个十年前，因酒后跌入塘子里淹死的贾四儿？」
「老爷好记性，这贾四儿当初包了庄子上一块儿鱼塘。」赖升笑着说道：「这贾四儿，说来，也算是我们东府里的一支了，当初横死，老爷还让公府中支了银子呢，这位珩大爷平日和蓉哥儿也常在一起厮混呢。」
贾珍放下酒盅，缕了缕一撮小胡子，笑道：「既是如此，倒也不是外人，让人给他五十两银子，再在外面铺子中，留个差事，让他退了这门婚事就是。」
赖升笑呵呵道：「老爷慈悲，这位珩大爷的母亲，年前也病故了，家里日子过的也紧巴巴的，若老爷给他个差事，不定多高兴呢。」
贾珍笑了笑，摆了摆手，道：「终究是我贾族晚辈，我为贾家族长，照应也是应有之义，是吧，秦老大人。」

说着，将一双意有所指的目光，看向秦业，给予适当的压迫。
「这……」秦业沉吟了下，一时沉吟不语。
贾珍倒也不愿逼迫过甚，笑了笑，拿起桌上的酒盅，抿了一口，试探问道：「既是这样，这门亲事？」
秦业心头犯难，正讷讷不知何以对之时，忽地，就听到楼梯处传来声音，「老爷，家里来了亲戚，吴嬷嬷让您回去呢。」
秦业闻言，心下一松，抬眸看向贾珍，拱手道：贾大人，下官家中还有事，至于亲事，容下官回去思量思量如何？」
贾珍面色就有不虞之色显露，但也不好强留，笑了笑，道：「那我静候秦老大人的佳音，老大人慢走。」
待秦业随着仆人下了陶然居，贾珍脸上的笑意才渐渐敛去，掌中摺扇「刷」地在掌中展开，轻轻在掌中拍打着扇子，面色阴晴不定，目中若有所思。
「老爷，要不要现在派人去贾四儿家？」赖升上前，小声问道。
贾珍顿了扇子，笑了笑道：「先不忙，让人唤蓉哥儿来。」
他身为宁国长房，贾族族长，这些事情还是要注意一些风评，尽量办得滴水不漏一些，料那贾珩也不敢违逆于他。
秦业出了陶然居，边向家走，路上就问着仆人，道：「哪个亲戚来了？」
仆人道：「老爷，是宁荣街柳条胡同的贾珩。」
秦业面色一变，心道，怎麽会这般巧。
「有没有说什麽事儿？」秦业问道。
仆人道：「也没说什麽，只是说过来拜访老爷。」
秦业面上现出一抹苦涩，拜访？那少年已近十五岁，多半是来求亲完婚的，这可如何是好？
神京城中，贾家一门两国公，家势鼎盛，于朝中更是树大根深，别看刚刚那贾珍说的客气，若是拂了其面子，祸福难料啊。
但，他若是弃贾族寒门而将小女许配给宁国府，这嫌贫爱富的名声，一旦传扬出去……
秦业此刻心头涌起一股苦涩，想了想，觉得还是回去见过那贾珩再说，先看看来意，就这般行了两刻钟，返回家中。
花厅之中，贾珩正与吴嬷嬷随意闲聊着，茶都吃了二盏，见始终不得秦业回返，虽心头疑惑，但面色不显。

方才，他已见过秦可卿，当真是明媚动人，丽色天成，红颜祸水，大概说的就是这种女子。
「老爷回来了。」就在这时，廊檐下的仆人喊道。
贾珩徇声而望，见一头发灰白，身穿常衫的老者，四平八稳步入花厅，连忙起身，拱手一礼道：「贾珩见过世伯。」
「是贤侄啊。」秦业打量了一眼贾珩，说来，这还是他第一次见贾珩，见其一身士子青衫，眉宇英气逼人，心头也暗暗道了一声。
原本以为是出身贾家旁枝，出身寒微，会有自卑自贱之色，不意竟是一表人才，此事愈发难办了。
二人再次落座，有丫鬟换了一壶新茶，秦业与对面少年寒暄几句，与之交谈，见其对答如流，神态从容。
贾珩就拿出婚书，道：「不瞒世伯，家慈在时，唯一之念就是看小侄成家立业，而今小侄正当适龄，特来求访世伯，已完婚事。」
秦业沉吟了下，觉得还是不让宁国府提亲一事道明才好，如果贾家有法使贾珩退婚，他或许也……
相比宁国府的正牌公子，旁支无疑是多有不及的。
这也是人之常情。
秦业道：「贤侄，当年定婚之事，自当践行，只是小女时常说要在家中再陪老夫二年，贤侄不若先将这婚书收好，再缓二年如何？」
贾珩笑了笑，道：「秦世伯，此事可有为难之处？」
方才进门之时，见这位秦世伯眉眼间藏有一抹忧愁之色，尤其在看到自己时，那忧愁之色更盛三分。
前世他在西南边防稽查，面对形形色色的入境者，早已学了一套察颜观色的方法。

content_en:
This teahouse stands in the prosperous area of ​​Dahan Shenjing. At this moment, several people are sitting on the second floor talking to each other.
"Unknown Master, I have called for a lower official. What's the important matter?" Qin Ye is an old man over fifty years old with gray hair. He looked at Jia Zhen opposite him humbly and said that he should be worthy of a lower official.
Jia Zhen inherited the title of Ning Guogong. Although she had been reduced several times, she still inherited the title of a third-class mighty general. Compared with Qin Ye's fifth-rank doctor in the Camp Catering Department of the Ministry of Industry, the rank was much higher, not to mention the special status of the head of the Jia clan. Qin Ye naturally did not dare to make mistakes when facing Jia Zhen.
Jia Zhen is in her early forties, wearing a light green official robe and a black gauze-less black hat. She has a fair complexion and a beard under her nose. She holds a folding fan in her hand and plays with it. With a smile on her face, she says with a smile: "Mr. Qin, you're welcome, Qin." The boss and I, the Jia family, have been friends for a long time. I really want to discuss something with Mr. Qin. My son, Jia Rong, has reached the age of marriage. I heard that Mr. Qin has a daughter who has a good appearance and a suitable family. Therefore, I have the audacity to propose marriage to Mr. Qin on my behalf. "
As Jia Zhen spoke, the sunken eye sockets and cloudy eyes seemed to reveal a charming and affectionate beauty like a flower.
On the eve of the Mid-Autumn Festival, he visited Da'an Temple and bumped into them. Later, after asking around a lot, he found out that they were the Qin siblings who came to offer incense and fulfill their wishes. Their father was a doctor in the Catering Department of the Ministry of Industry, and he was in the fifth rank.
"Your Majesty..." Qin Ye looked hesitant on his face and said, "To be honest with Mr. Jia, my daughter has already been engaged. How can one daughter marry two families?"
Jia Zhen frowned, her face changed slightly, and she said anxiously: "Are you engaged? I wonder which young master it is?"
Qin Ye pondered for a moment, deliberately not telling the truth, but looking at Jia Zhen's scrutinizing gaze, he said, "Speaking of it, he is still a member of the Jia clan."
"Oh?" Jia Zhen's face paused slightly, her eyes brightened, and she said in surprise: "Which young master is in the same room, why don't I know?"
Jia Zhen is the head of the Jia family, but he doesn't know if there are any men of suitable age to get married in the two houses. Baoyu is still young, and Jia Lian only got married a few years ago. How can ordinary people make a marriage arrangement...
Jia Zhen's eyes flashed, and she felt relieved. If it was a marriage arranged by the Jia family in Jing, as the clan leader, he would use some money, coercion and inducement, and he would not dare to disobey his wishes.
Qin Ye paused for a moment and then said hesitantly: "It's Jia Si's family from Liutiao'er Alley in the back street. His nickname is Brother Heng. He made a baby bride not long after he was born and has already exchanged the marriage certificate."
At the end of the story, Qin Ye sighed in his heart. Back then, he was just a small official in the Ministry of Industry, and because of the favor he received from Jia Si'er and his wife, he arranged a baby marriage.
But times have changed, and the marriage that was originally a good match is now more or less... But even if he regrets the marriage, he will definitely not do such a shameless thing.
Jia Zhen frowned and asked Lai Sheng beside her, "Jia Si'er from the backstreet? But the Jia Si'er who fell into the pond and drowned after being drunk ten years ago?"
"I have a good memory. This Jia Si'er originally owned a fish pond on Zhuangzi." Lai Sheng said with a smile: "This Jia Si'er, speaking of it, can be regarded as a member of our Dongfu. When he died unexpectedly, I even asked the government to pay him money. This uncle Heng and Brother Rong often hang out together."
Jia Zhen put down the wine cup, tied a wisp of her mustache, and said with a smile: "In that case, he is not an outsider. Just ask someone to give him fifty taels of silver, and then leave an errand in the shop outside to ask him to cancel the marriage."
Lai Sheng said with a smile, "I have mercy on you. Uncle Heng's mother also died of illness a few years ago, and life at home is very tight. I would be very happy if I gave him an errand."
Jia Zhen smiled, waved her hand and said, "After all, I am a junior of the Jia family. As the head of the Jia family, it is my duty to take care of you, right, Mr. Qin."
As he spoke, he gave a pair of pointed eyes, looked at Qin Ye and gave appropriate pressure.
"This..." Qin Ye pondered for a moment and was silent for a while.
Jia Zhen didn't want to push too hard, so she smiled, picked up the wine cup on the table, took a sip, and asked tentatively: "In that case, is this a marriage?"
Qin Ye was troubled, and just when he was confused and didn't know what to say, he suddenly heard a voice coming from the stairs, "Master, there are relatives at home, and Grandma Wu asked you to go back."
Hearing this, Qin Ye felt relieved. He raised his eyes to look at Jia Zhen, cupped his hands and said, "Master Jia, I have something to do at home. As for the marriage, how about I allow you to go back and think about it?" "
Jia Zhen's face showed a look of concern, but she couldn't force it away. She smiled and said, "Then I will wait for Mr. Qin's good news. Mr. Qin will go slowly."
After Qin Ye followed his servant down to Tao Ranju, the smile on Jia Zhen's face gradually faded away. She unfolded the folding fan in her palm and flapped it gently in her palm. Her face was uncertain and her eyes were thoughtful.
"Master, do you want to send someone to Jia Si'er's house now?" Lai Sheng stepped forward and asked in a low voice.
Jia Zhen paused her fan, smiled and said, "Don't be busy now, let someone call Brother Rong."
As the head of the Ning Kingdom and the head of the Jia Clan, he still had to pay attention to the public opinion on these matters and try to handle them as leak-proof as possible. It was expected that Jia Heng would not dare to disobey him.
Qin Ye left Tao Ranju and walked home. On the way, he asked his servant, "Which relative is here?"
The servant said: "Sir, this is Jia Heng from Liutiao Hutong, Ningrong Street."
Qin Ye's expression changed and he thought, how could it be such a coincidence.
"Did you say something?" Qin Ye asked.
The servant said: "I didn't say anything, I just said I came to visit the master."
There was a touch of bitterness on Qin Ye's face. Visit? The young man is nearly fifteen years old, and he is probably here to propose marriage. What should he do?
In the city of Shenjing, the Jia family has a prosperous family with two princes, and it is a big tree with deep roots in the court. Regardless of the politeness Jia Zhen said just now, if it offends his face, it will be unpredictable.
However, if he abandons the poor family of the Jia clan and betroths his daughter to the Ningguo Mansion, once his reputation of hating the poor and loving the rich spreads...
Qin Ye felt a sense of bitterness in his heart at this moment. After thinking about it, he decided that it would be better to go back and see Jia Heng first to see what his purpose was. He walked like this for two quarters of an hour and returned home.
In the flower hall, Jia Heng was chatting casually with Grandma Wu. They had two cups of tea. Seeing that Qin Ye never came back, although he was confused, his expression was not obvious.
Just now, he had met Qin Keqing. She was really beautiful and charming, her beauty was natural, her beauty was a disaster, she probably meant this kind of woman.
"The master is back." At this moment, the servant under the eaves shouted.
Jia Heng looked around and saw an old man with gray hair and wearing a regular shirt, walking steadily into the flower hall. He stood up quickly, cupped his hands and saluted, "Jia Heng has met Shibo."
"He's a good nephew." Qin Ye took a look at Jia Heng. Speaking of it, this was the first time he saw Jia Heng. When he saw that he was wearing a green shirt and his eyebrows were heroic, he thought to himself.
I originally thought that he was from a branch of the Jia family, with a humble background, and would have a low self-esteem. Unexpectedly, he turned out to be a talented person, and the matter became increasingly difficult to handle.
The two sat down again, and a maid brought a new pot of tea. Qin Ye exchanged a few words with the young man opposite and talked with him. He saw that his answers were fluent and his expression was calm.
Jia Heng took out the marriage certificate and said, "To be honest with you, Uncle Shi, when Jia Ci was here, his only thought was to see his nephew get married and start a business. Now that my nephew is of the right age, he came here to ask for a visit from Uncle Shi. The marriage has been completed."
Qin Ye pondered for a moment and felt that it would be better not to let Ningguo Mansion make the marriage proposal clear. If the Jia family had a way to make Jia Heng break off the engagement, he might also...
Compared with the real master of Ningguo Mansion, the side branches are undoubtedly inferior.
This is also human nature.
Qin Ye said: "My dear nephew, you should practice the engagement you made back then. However, my daughter often said that she would stay with my husband at home for another two years. My dear nephew, why not arrange this marriage first?"Put the book away, how about delaying it for another two years? "
Jia Heng smiled and said, "Qin Shibo, is there any difficulty in this matter?"
When he just entered the door, he saw a look of sadness hidden in Qin Shibo's eyebrows. Especially when he saw himself, the look of sadness became even stronger.
In his previous life, he was inspecting the southwest border and faced all kinds of immigrants, so he had already learned a set of methods of observing faces.
